scope: Cosmos T5 embedding experiment provenance preflight
summary: The first embedding experiment was stopped before T5 model loading because its official uv environment has no pip module and the launcher silently wrote an empty package inventory.
evidence: packages.txt is zero bytes while command.txt, experiment-config.json, and gpu-selection.json preserve the attempted launch.
The controller and orphaned worker were both resolved and terminated; physical GPU 5 returned to 72,576 MiB free.
No T5 pickle was written to the formal training dataset by this attempt.
The shared provenance helper now inventories importlib.metadata distributions directly and returns 163 packages, including torch==2.6.0+cu126, in the official environment.
lessons: A successful environment sync does not imply that python -m pip is installed.
Package provenance must fail closed or use a standard-library fallback instead of accepting empty stdout from a best-effort command.
limitations: This attempt contains no embedding or model-quality evidence.
next_actions: Run the corrected launcher in a new experiment directory and require a non-empty package inventory plus 172 hash-bound embeddings.
